propositions: When an ephemeral runner's final push is rejected after the Jira rebar-id label is stamped but before the local CREATE event and binding are durably published, the local state is lost while the Jira label persists, creating an unhealed unbound_jira drift.
The existing binding_walk L10 guard stands down on any rebar-id label presence, preventing re-adoption of marked-but-unstored keys when local state was lost.
The fix implements idempotent recovery by replaying the adopt when the rebar-id marker equals the deterministic inbound local id, no binding-store entry exists, and no local ticket exists.
Recovery is keyed on deterministic inbound identity (_jira_key_to_local_id) to ensure replayed adopts converge on the same local id and binding without creating duplicates.
The L10 guard condition becomes conditional rather than unconditional: foreign markers, multi-marker keys, keys with pending store entries, and retired keys continue standing down.
bridge_fsck unbound_jira audit remains untouched and continues alerting until the binding actually exists post-recovery.
